correctness.rationale: The full zero-dipole sector has Bloch X=diag(1,T), trace T=1, each eigenvalue at most 1; at most one negative eigenvalue. Antipodal symmetrization strictly removes the dipole of any coherent mixture without changing second moments, and every trace-one PSD 3x3 matrix is realized. The original squared Hilbert-Schmidt distance equals one quarter the squared Frobenius difference, not its square root. For negative eigenvalue λ, T*=T+(λ/2)I-(3λ/2)vvᵀ is rank-two PSD trace-one; stationarity inequality (3λ/2)⟨v,Sv⟩≤0 for all trace-one PSD S proves the unique global projection and Q²=3λ²/8. The three direction/weight construction has mean zero, second moment T*, and its Bloch rank three precludes fewer coherent components. Similarity of the symmetric two-qubit partial transpose with Bloch X/2 gives exactly one possible negative eigenvalue λ/2, hence N=−λ/2 and Q=√(3/2)N. At λ≥0 the state is already classical. The nonaxial rational example has Q²=3/32 and N=1/4, matching the formula. The verifier samples only finite rational states; the variational proof is continuum-wide.
